content: Nkpa Pɔpwɛ Tsiá
Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ Bulu lakʋ́sʋ́a mlɩa Kristonyɔ ba nkpa pɔpwɛtɔ á, mlɩdunka atɔ́á ɩbʋ ɔsʋ́sʋ́, ɔtɩ́nɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ Kristo tsie Bulu gyɔpɩsʋ ámʋ.
Mlɩha agywɩɩn ɩnʋ atɔ́ ɩwɩ, megyí ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ klɛ́.
Tsúfɛ́ mlɩlawú, Bulu lapʋ́ mlɩa Kristonyɔ nkpa onutó ŋáín mʋtɔ.
Ɛkɛá ɔbɛ́lɛ Kristo amʋ́ʋ́ ogyi mlɩ nkpa onutó ámʋ ɔwan súná ɔyɩ́ á, ɛkɛ ámʋ kɛ́n ɔbɛ́lɛ mlɩa mʋnyɔ ɔwan mʋ numnyamtɔ nɩ́.
Tsiátɔ́ Dada Mʋ́a Pɔ́pwɛ

Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩmɔ tsiátɔ́ dada amʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ mlɩtɔ ámʋ. Mʋ́gyí; atsɩ mʋ́a ayin asʋ́nwa, ifintotsiá, ɔwɔ́lɩ laláhɛ mʋ́a pɛ́lɩla. Ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ atɔ wankláán ɩmápɛ mlɩ ansɩ́, tsúfɛ́ ɔnsɩ́pɛ igyi fɛ́ ɔkpɩsúm.
Ntobí ánfɩ odu abwɛpʋ́sʋ́ Bulu tɛhɩ́ɛ́ nyá ɔblɔ́ nɩ́.
Mʋ́ aná mlɩtɔbwɛ́ brɛ́á mlɩgyí ɔmátɔ́fɔ nɩ́.
Séi gyí brɛ́á mlɛ́lɛ ɔblɔ́, ɔblɔ́kpán, olu, abakpɔɩ́, asʋkpan blɩ́ aná lɛ́ mlɩtɔ nɩ́.
Mlɩmáwa afunu súná aba, tsúfɛ́ mlɩlasí mlɩ tsiátɔ́ dada amʋ pʋ́ mʋ́ bwɛhɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́.
Mlɩlalátsú tsiátɔ́ pɔpwɛ. Bulu gyí mʋ́ Ɔbwɛpʋ́, ɔdɛ mʋ́ bwɛ pɔ́pwɛ lɩan mʋ ɩwɩ brɛ́ ánfɩ mlɩdɛ́ mʋ bɩ ánfɩ.

Tsiátɔ́ pɔpwɛ anfɩ mʋ́ á, ɩmɛfáhʋn ánɩ́ Griikiyin ntɛ́ɛ Yudayin fʋgyi. Fɛtɩn keté ntɛ́ɛ fʋmɛtɩn, ɔkpʋtɔ́pʋ ntɛ́ɛ okudasɩ́yin, ɔkpábi ntɛ́ɛ ɔdɩ́hɩɛ fʋ́gyi. Kristo gyí tógyítɔ́, ɔbʋ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɩ́nɩá Bulu lalɛ́ mlɩ pʋ́bwɛ́ mʋ ahá ánɩ́ amʋ́ ɩwɩ latɩn pʋ́ mʋ adwɛpʋ́ á, mlɩha nwewúun, awɩtɔlɛwa, ɩwɩasɩbá, ilwií pʋ́ klʋnya itsia mlɩtɔ.
Mlɩnya ɩklʋn ha aba. Nɩ́ ɔkʋ mʋa mʋ ba benya á, mlɩsikie aba fɛ́ alɩá Kristo lési mlɩ klɛ́ kíé mlɩ.
Mʋ́á ɩdʋn a, ɔdwɛ tɔ́bwɛ́ anɩ fɛ́ɛ́ ɩkʋlɛ. Ɩbwɛ́ɛ mlɩ tati dɩdáhɛ́.
Mlɩha Kristo iwilwii igyí mlɩ klʋnsʋ, tsúfɛ́ mʋ́tɔ́ Bulu latɩ́ mlɩ bɔwa; mlɩa mʋ nyankpʋsa-oyí ámʋ mlɩlabwɛ́ kʋlɛ nɩ. Mlɩda mʋ ɩpán ɛ́ brégyíbrɛ́.
Mlɩha Kristo asʋ́n ámʋ ɩhɩɛ bʋla mlɩ klʋntɔ, ɩha mlɩ nyánsa. Mlɩpʋtɔɩ kpla aba, suna aba atɔ́. Mlɩwa Israelfɔ ɩlʋ, ɔsankuosʋ ɩlʋ pʋ́ ɔŋɛ́tɔ́ ɩlʋ mlɩ klʋntɔ pʋtsu Bulu fʋa, pʋda anɩ Sɩ́ Bulu ɩpán.
Mlɩ atɔ bwɛhɛ́ pʋ́ mlɩ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́ ɩbwɛ́ɛ anɩ Wíe Yesu ɩdátɔ́, amlɩpʋ ɩpán ha anɩ Sɩ́ Bulu tsʋn mʋsʋ.
Akristofɔ Tsiátɔ́
Aká, mlɩba ɩwɩasɩ ha mlɩ akúlu alɩá ɩlɛkanáa ha ahá ánɩ́ bʋgyi Kristo klɛ́.
Akúlu, mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩdwɛ mlɩ aká. Mlɩmábwɛ amʋ́ kpóunkpóun.
Abí, mlɩbu mlɩ akwɩɩ́pʋ́, tsúfɛ́ mʋ́ Bulu tekle nɩ.
Akwɩɩ́pʋ́, mlɩmáwa mlɩ abí ɔblɔ́, mɛ́nɩ ɩwɩ móowu amʋ́.
Nkpábi, mlɩbu mlɩ ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ awíe tógyítɔ́á mlɔ́bwɛtɔ. Mlɩha amʋ́ ansɩ́ igyi mlɩ ɩwɩ brégyíbrɛ́, megyí amʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́ wʋlɛ. Mlɩbwɛ mʋ́ tsú klʋntɔ, tsúfɛ́ mlɩtobú anɩ Wíe.
Mlɩbwɛ tógyítɔ́ tsu mlɩ klʋntɔ, fɛ́ anɩ Wíe mlɩdɛ́ mʋ́ bwɛ há, megyí anyánkpʋ́sa.
Mlɩkaɩn ánɩ́ anɩ Wíe ɩbɩtɔ mlénya mlɩ ɩkɔká ánɩ́ alalá yáɩ́ mʋ abí. Tsúfɛ́ Kristo gyí Owíe ánɩ́ mlɩdésum.
Támɛ nɩ́ fɔbwɛ́ tɔ́á ɩma alɛ a, ɔbɛ́ka fʋ́ ɩkɔ, tsúfɛ́ ɔtamakɩ ɔhaa ansɩ́tɔ́.
